basis: All parameters are analyst judgments except the SF Controller net-home scale anchor 8041/13615. Policy attribution is conditional on the allocated $50000, bundles funding response, c3-eligible delivery, other actors and own past/future funded cohorts. Do not apply allocation again. Policy residual is the share of source-scale housing still alterable beyond adopted law/public baseline, not a second probability of the same action.
interpretation: Central and joint stress scenarios, not a probability distribution. No tuning to a favorable ranking. DPP favorable 100 homes remains unverified; source-scale is not an estimate of HAC-produced housing. General 20% allocation fully costed with no separate quantified benefit.
